title: REQ · Opening dialogue and choices progress and update game state
summary: Opening choices lead to follow-up dialogue nodes that change state
description: Context: bedroom.yaml intro choices have no next or events, so choosing them only appends history and ends dialogue. Desired: each choice moves to a node with new text and choices and sets a flag. Expected: dialogue and choice progression visible in the store. Why: story panel shows real progression.
acceptance_criteria: Given a new game, when started, then activeDialogue is intro with the exact text and two choices
Given intro, when choice 0 "Look around the room" is chosen, then activeDialogue becomes look-around and flag looked_around is true
Given intro, when choice 1 "Let's explore" is chosen, then activeDialogue becomes explore and flag exploring is true
Given a terminal choice, when chosen, then activeDialogue is null
